title: Biostratigraphy of the Middendorf Formation (Upper Cretaceous) in a corehole at Myrtle Beach, South Carolina
citation: Gohn, G.S., Dowsett, H.J., and Sohl, N.F., 1992, Biostratigraphy of the Middendorf Formation (Upper Cretaceous) in a corehole at Myrtle Beach, South Carolina: U.S. Geological Survey Bulletin 2030 [12 p.], map scale 1:117,332.
notes: Two-column text is interleaved line by line; quotes are taken from single column runs. Depths for corehole H0-973 come from the text (pp. 7, 9, 14); figures 3 and 4 (electric logs) are unreadable in the text layer and were skipped. Table 1 (fossil occurrences by sample depth, p. 12) is not recorded sample by sample. Taxonomic notes (pp. 14-15) not recorded. References: only those bearing on Carolina Coastal Plain geology are recorded; purely paleontological/taxonomic references (foraminifera, ostracode and mollusk monographs, Gulf Coast and European works) were skipped. 'Rattner' in the Hattner and Wise 1980 reference is as printed in the text layer.
